subject.title: fix: beta releases require manual reruns after plugin publication

question: Should a beta core release be considered publishable as `beta-live` while plugin npm and ClawHub convergence continue asynchronously, rather than requiring ecosystem convergence in the parent release workflow?
rationale: This is a deliberate release-completion and operator-recovery policy change; code review can validate mechanisms but cannot choose the repository’s acceptable beta release contract.

options.title: Adopt beta-live completion
options.body: Allow beta core publication after its required core evidence succeeds, retain visible asynchronous plugin convergence and repair evidence, and keep stable and explicit-wait modes blocking.

options.title: Keep ecosystem-blocking betas
options.body: Require plugin npm and ClawHub convergence before the beta parent reports successful completion, preserving the prior single blocking release contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt beta-live completion
recommendation.body: Allow beta core publication after its required core evidence succeeds, retain visible asynchronous plugin convergence and repair evidence, and keep stable and explicit-wait modes blocking.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current release-orchestration proposal and can route the requested release-policy confirmation to the appropriate release owners.
